how can i use Hydi

Hydi is a tool for monitoring and managing your infrastructure services in real-time. It provides information about your cloud environments, such as Vercel, AWS, Azure, and others, allowing you to monitor their health, performance, and availability. You can use Hydi to view logs, metrics, and other data related to your infrastructure services.

To get started with Hydi, you will need to install it on your system and configure it to connect to the various cloud environments where your services are deployed. Once Hydi is installed and configured, you can use it to monitor and manage your infrastructure services in real-time.

You can also use Hydi's API to programmatically access its data and perform automated tasks. This can be useful for automating monitoring and management workflows, as well as for integrating Hydi with other tools and systems.
